C0196.title: Python Script for Automated Bulk Following on Instagram
C0196.summary: An Alibaba Cloud Developer Community repost describes how the author used an open-source Python bot and small paid promotion to gain real Instagram followers. The article discusses automated following, content interaction, and follower-growth tactics, illustrating how bulk following and automation can be used to inflate social-account influence.

references.title: Using a Python Open-Source Bot and $5, I Got 2,500 Real Followers on Instagram
How I setup an Instagram Bot after 6 months of studying Python
